title: GraQle Proof Bundle
description: A tamper-evidence proof bundle: a governed-trace record, its RFC 6962 inclusion proof, and an ed25519 signature over the batch root. Spec version 1.0, versioned independently of the GraQle SDK release train.

proof_format_version.description: Wire-format version of this bundle. TYPE-constrained but deliberately NOT value-constrained at spec v1.0: this field is covered by the signature (it is part of the signed preimage), so a verifier must treat it as opaque bytes and MUST NOT rewrite or normalize it. Doing so would change the signed preimage and invalidate an otherwise-valid signature. It must equal the value carried inside the record.

record.description: The governed-trace record this proof attests. It MUST itself carry proof_format_version. Only a frozen allowlist of record fields contributes to the leaf hash; fields outside that allowlist provably cannot alter the leaf.

leaf.description: Position and hash of this record's leaf within the batch tree.

leaf_index.description: Zero-based position of the leaf in the tree.

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in the tree.

leaf_hash.description: The record's RFC 6962 domain-separated leaf hash.

merkle.description: The RFC 6962 inclusion (audit) proof binding the leaf to the batch root.

merkle_root.description: The batch root the signature commits to.

merkle_path.description: Sibling hashes, bottom-up. Same length as merkle_path_directions.

merkle_path_directions.description: Per sibling: 0 = sibling on the left, 1 = sibling on the right. Integers, never booleans (JCS interop).

signature.description: An ed25519 signature over the canonicalized root-commitment message.

alg.description: Only ed25519 is accepted at spec v1.0.

kid.description: Key identifier, resolved against the verifier's trusted keyring.

signed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the signature was made. This is the instant a verifier evaluates key trust against.

rekor.description: OPTIONAL offline transparency-log receipt. Treated strictly as DATA and never fetched. Its absence does not make a bundle invalid: a locally-anchored proof is valid without a public-log receipt.

hex32.description: A 32-byte hash as 64 lowercase hex characters.
